flowchart LR
  subgraph IN["삽입(push·enqueue)"]
    A1["삽입 요청"] --> A2{"isFull()?"}
    A2 -->|"예"| A3["오버플로"]
    A2 -->|"아니오"| A4["저장 후 top·rear 증가"]
  end
  subgraph OUT["삭제(pop·dequeue)"]
    B1["삭제 요청"] --> B2{"isEmpty()?"}
    B2 -->|"예"| B3["언더플로"]
    B2 -->|"아니오"| B4["반환 후 top 감소·front 증가"]
  end
overflow-underflow.pseudocode:
MAX = 5
stack = [None] * MAX
top = -1  # 빈 스택

def push(x):
    global top
    if top == MAX - 1:  # isFull
        raise OverflowError('stack overflow')
    top += 1
    stack[top] = x

def pop():
    global top
    if top == -1:  # isEmpty
        raise IndexError('stack underflow')
    x = stack[top]
    top -= 1
    return x
